segments.en: One should rouse oneself to arise before dawn to engage in the service of Hashem Yisborach. Through this one merits completeness of faith — and the light of truth and great da'as shines upon one — and one merits to enter all the gates of holiness. At the light of morning one should raise one's eyes heavenward and gaze upon the sky.
